evidence.citation: “Then re-evaluate all three cases” using fresh context-free agents, checkout/leak inspection, separate blind judges, before/after reporting, and a repeated three-case sweep only “If any case still fails—or a previously passing case regresses.”
evidence.criterion: C1: The artifact does not require materially unnecessary execution work under the supplied cost evaluation bar.

rationale: The three-case rerun verifies the revision and detects regressions; fresh agents, leak inspection, and separate judges protect isolation and provenance. Repeating the sweep is conditional on a remaining failure or new regression, so the artifact does not require materially unnecessary work.
